data.name: Veles: Rise of the Damned
data.detailed_description:
Step into a world of darkness in Veles: Rise of the Damned.

Face endless hordes of cursed creatures, build unstoppable power, and carve your path through a realm ruled by ancient gods and forgotten horrors.

Fight, evolve, and survive in a fast-paced action roguelite inspired by games like Vampire Survivors.

Choose your hero, unlock powerful abilities, collect gear, and create devastating builds as you battle through waves of enemies and face brutal bosses.

Set in a dark fantasy world inspired by Slavic mythology, Veles: Rise of the Damned blends gothic atmosphere with deep character progression and build customization.

Features:
• Multiple heroes with unique playstyles
• Deep skill tree and progression systems
• Hundreds of upgrades, items, and modifiers
• Intense endgame scaling with massive enemy waves
• Dark fantasy world with angels, demons, and ancient forces
• Replayable runs with endless build combinations

Every run is different. Experiment with builds, adapt your strategy, and push further each time.

This game is currently in development. Content, balance, and features may change over time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Performance may vary during late-game scenarios with high enemy counts and visual effects.

content_descriptors.notes:
Veles: Rise of the Damned is a dark fantasy action-survival game featuring combat against supernatural enemies including undead, demons, wolves, spiders, and vampires.

Violence: The game contains stylized fantasy violence. Players use abilities to defeat waves of enemies. Combat involves creatures being destroyed, with no realistic gore or graphic depictions of injury. Violence is gameplay-focused and arcade in nature, consistent with the genre (similar to Vampire Survivors).

Themes: The game explores dark fantasy themes including death, the undead, damnation, and supernatural evil. Enemy types include skeletons, reapers, wraiths, and a Vampire Lord. Ability names and progression systems reference darkness and damnation as thematic flavor.

There is no sexual content, nudity, drug use, self-harm, or depictions of real-world violence in this game.
